envelope.description: Add vibe-adapter.ts turn execution: live event production, process-group cleanup, exit-evidence readback, and naming

body.title: Add vibe-adapter.ts turn execution: live event production, process-group cleanup, exit-evidence readback, and naming
body.summary: Completes src/shared/vibe-adapter.ts: startTurn's live JSONL event production for outputMode:'streaming' (session/status/assistant-text/tool-call/tool-result/error variants) and final-message mapping for text/json modes; the dual process-group policy with termination/descendant-exit-confirmation/temp-file cleanup on every exit path (adapter-owned and supervisor-owned); exit-evidence readback from --output-dir export.json (stopReason, outcome, effectiveSelection), treating a missing/malformed export as absent evidence rather than fabricated; VibeMcpNaming.fromStreamedName (general insrc MCP tool identity) and the VibeInsrcAnalysisToolId allowlist (restricted); and runVibeTurn(options), the adapter-owned turn entry whose signature totally maps the plugin's existing VibeTurnOptions onto context+request with no chat behavior change.
acceptanceChecks: every exit path (success, abort/deadline, spawn failure) removes the turn's temporary files; adapter-owned mode additionally sweeps the child group on every exit path
a 'session' event opens every turn carrying the native session id and, for a new session, the resume handle
the result carries exit evidence (stopReason, outcome, effectiveSelection) read back from export.json; a missing/malformed export.json yields undefined evidence rather than a fabricated value
VibeMcpNaming.fromStreamedName returns undefined for a name matching no insrc MCP tool, never a guess

a streaming turn whose tool-result arrives with outputText absent but output present (and vice versa; and an error-only result) yields the normalized OUTPUT per the existing chat precedence, never an empty payload
runVibeTurn's parameter mapping from VibeTurnOptions is total: every field the plugin's existing options object carries maps onto the adapter's context+request with no silently dropped option

tests.name: adapter argv construction — a request with no model/thinking adds no --model/--thinking flags and writes the prompt to the tool's programmatic input (stdin), never into argv
a new-session request with model+thinking constructs the argv with --model/--thinking; a resumed-session request constructs --resume only and the type forbids selection
the adapter recognizes the tool's selection-failure wording and raises VibeSelectionError before any model call, not retried by withTransientRetry
every exit path removes the turn's temporary files; adapter-owned mode additionally sweeps the child group on every exit path
a 'session' event opens every turn carrying the native session id and, for a new session, the resume handle
exit evidence is read back from export.json; a missing/malformed export.json yields undefined evidence rather than a fabricated value
VibeMcpNaming.fromStreamedName returns undefined for a name matching no insrc MCP tool, never a guess
a streaming tool-result with outputText/output/error/reason normalizes to the existing chat precedence, never an empty payload
INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1 — a real vibe -p turn with a bogus alias surfaces the tool's real catalog; a valid model/thinking completes
